observation: During a controlled wardrobe-runtime failure, dry selections could resolve to missing/invalid outfits, unrelated geometry, or the wrong character. Activating Change Wetness restored the correct selected character model while wet state was active; this was observed for Hinako and other girls.
supported: the wetness transition is a separate and useful runtime state transition worth tracing
character identity can be recovered correctly during wet state despite a broken dry wardrobe state
before/after wetness tracing may reveal wet-specific model, costume, material, shader, coverage, or asset routing
not_proven: that the wetness handler directly controls alpha or transparency
that wet and dry necessarily use separate model or mesh files
that the buggy wardrobe-runtime cache behavior belongs in normal Restoration
that synthetic Generation 10 v2 BKN records are required
that any current shader, material, texture, or entry-23 candidate is correct
suggested_read_only_trace: current costume/index or resolved costume state
preferred_comparison: normal native costume dry->wet versus the same character/state under a Restoration-only wet-clothing candidate
